name: Beanro
summary: Loud, playful coffee shop site in cream, roast brown and orange with an ultra-wide all-caps display face, a cut-out liquid splash hero over thin vertical grid lines, product-shot drink cards and a brown slab with tilted sticker tags.

fonts.pairing: Boldonse ultra-wide caps for the loudest lines, Bayon condensed caps for card titles and secondary heads, Manrope for body and uppercase labels

signature: cut-out liquid splash floating under a two-line ultra-wide caps headline, with faint vertical column rules running behind
rounded roast-brown slab where one phrase sits in a tilted orange box and small pill stickers in mustard, sage and orange hang off the headline at angles
drink cards on a slightly darker cream with isolated product shots, condensed caps name, price left and orange text link right
giant brand wordmark at the foot of the page
imagery: isolated drink cut-outs on transparent backgrounds (iced lattes, cold brew, whipped drinks), liquid splashes, warm café interiors
layout_grid: 1440px canvas, 60px side padding, 160px gaps between sections, large 32 to 60px rounded panels, 3-column product grid, pill tabs and pill buttons
